execution: Actual local CPU inference with upstream PCA ADAPT; 1 checkpoint, no retraining. Joint covariance propagated through pressure integration. Not independent experimental validation.
domain: Published Re > 1e6; alpha [-4,12] deg; Mach [0,.9]. Re is context only and not consumed by ADAPT. No low-Re calibration, friction/total drag, finite-wing lift or structural approval.

panel.note: Current Wing Lab 2D incompressible inviscid solver; 160 panels per surface, sampled geometry interpolated and trailing edge closed to the mean ordinate. ADAPT uses Mach .15 and its original section. Difference includes model form and trailing-edge treatment; it is not an error against experiment.
